Demo25 (Tsubaki, Hatsumode date) redone the standard layered way (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6): story unchanged, art = empty plate +
plain-background pose + drawn mouth / blink variants per view. Writes project/web_prompts.json for tools/openai/images.py
(refs d25:<view> = Demo25's flat stills, copied to assets/art/web/d25_<view>.jpg). Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

bg_torii.prompt:
Image 1 is the reference picture. Remove the young woman completely (and any hand or cup she holds) and fill the space with what is behind her — the same Japanese shrine on New Year's Eve night: snow, lanterns, navy sky, bokeh lights, distant crowd silhouettes — the same composition, colours, lighting and art style. Empty scene, no people.

Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

tsubaki_torii.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep the young woman EXACTLY as she is — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, face, hair strands, lineart, clothes and colours — and replace ONLY the dark grey background with a flat CHROMA-KEY GREEN (#00B140): one even colour everywhere around her and in every gap between her hair strands, no shadow, no gradient, no green on her. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.

tsubaki_torii_talk.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY her mouth: slightly open as if talking softly, a small natural opening, no teeth showing. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.

tsubaki_torii_blink.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY BOTH of her eyes: FULLY closed in a natural blink (upper eyelids all the way down on both eyes, lashes visible, no iris showing); her bangs stay exactly as they are. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.

Image 2 shows only the POSE, FRAMING and SCALE for this picture (its art style and her details there are older: follow image 1 for how she looks).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation with a light, airy palette, thin coloured lineart (dark lavender instead of black), flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy, no bloom. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi).

Tsubaki: the exact young woman from image 1 — very long silver-white hair in a loose low side ponytail tied with a red-and-white braided cord, soft pink-red eyes, a small red camellia pin; a white furisode fading to crimson at the sleeves with red camellias, a gold obi, a white fur stole.

Same pose as image 1: A street of food stalls (yatai) inside the shrine: glowing stall awnings, steam, hanging lanterns. She stands centre, turned toward you, holding up a small black credit card with an embarrassed, apologetic little smile, the other hand at her cheek. Mouth CLOSED (lips together) in the same expression.

SAME FRAMING AND SCALE as image 1: do NOT zoom out and do NOT draw more of her body than image 2 shows — her head, shoulders and hands are exactly where and as big as in image 2, cut by the picture edges in the same places. Leave out the viewer's hand / arm if image 2 has one.

Plain flat CHROMA-KEY GREEN background (#00B140), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no snow, no floor line, no shadow and no gradient on the background, no green on her. Keep the same lighting on her as in image 2 (warm lantern light, cool night fill).
